intent: A criteria suggestion is not paid for when none of it could be adopted.
observable_outcome: get-context testlab lists the amended rule as reviewed, proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Suggesting acceptance criteria is a model call the user starts, so it is open only to invited accounts, refused before the model is called when the test case already holds the most criteria it may or when the owner's credit balance is below the start threshold for suggest_criteria, and debited by the usage the gateway reported once the model answers; it never proposes more criteria than there is room for.
